body:
Incident Bot: P0: sudden spike in 5xx and timeouts seen at api-gateway across europe region. paging on-call: Alex K. @here :rotating_light:
Alex K.: I’m on it. first glance: gateway 502/504 and 5xx from runtime pool. seeing retries from edge -> upstream amplifying latency.
Maria P.: I’m jumping in. can someone paste a sample correlation id?
Jason L.: correlation id 2b7f3a9c from 12:02:11 UTC — gateway logs attached below.
Jason L.: ```
gateway: ts=2026-03-15T12:02:11Z cid=2b7f3a9c route=/v1/generate upstream=runtime-12 status=504 rs=3 retries=2 latency_ms=12000
```
Emma R.: same cid shows runtime retry loop in runtime logs: ```
runtime: ts=2026-03-15T12:02:11Z cid=2b7f3a9c model=redwood-base attempts=4 kv_cache_miss=true last_err="write timeout"
```
Infra SRE: Hypothesis 1: upstream runtime nodes hit GC/queue saturation causing long tail — retries at gateway cause pileup. Hypothesis 2: misbehaving model shard with slow step leading to backpressure.
Alex K.: Initial mitigation: disable gateway retry amplification for affected route and enable immediate fallback to smaller model variant. Maria, can you flip that?
Maria P.: On it. disabling retry policy for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 now. applying routing override: ```
PATCH /configs/routing
{ "route":"/v1/generate","retry_policy":"none","fallback":"redwood-small-v2" }
```
DeployBot: deploy started for routing override (deploy-id: d-7821)
Maria P.: override applied, traffic split 80/20 to fallback. monitoring.
Jason L.: dashboard: percent 5xx dropped from 6.2% -> 2.1% in last 90s. latency p95 down from 3.2s -> 1.1s.
Alex K.: Good. still need timeline reconstruction for RCA. Emma, can you gather runtime node-level logs and JVM/worker metrics for runtime-12 group between 11:55-12:10?
Emma R.: grabbing logs. also collecting heap, thread dumps. posting S3 link shortly.
Emma R.: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1862345601/runtime-12.tar.gz (includes thread-dumps, gc, netstat)
Infra SRE: quick look at netstat: many TIME_WAIT and backlog queue growing on runtime-12. also see kernel drop counters incrementing.
Jason L.: Also found a spike in long-tail request sizes around same window — unusually long prompts (user-batch test). may be client-side causing queuing.
Maria P.: Customer impact: telemetry shows ~12k requests failed in eu-west-1 over 10m window, small subset enabled retries causing duplicates for some customers. notifying account reps.
Alex K.: Can we reduce connection keepalive timeout and bump runtime worker count as a short-term capacity add?
Infra SRE: Increasing worker pool by +2 on runtime-12 now. applying soft limit bump.
DeployBot: scale action submitted for runtime-12 (scale +2) — expected effect within 45s.
Maria P.: Noted a config change rolled yesterday to gateway that touched retry jitter. rolling that back as another mitigation to test.
Alex K.: Action items while mitigated: 1) Emma to collect full traces + thread dumps (assigned). 2) Infra SRE to run load replay on staging with similar long prompts (assigned). 3) Product/Support to notify customers impacted (Maria). 4) Postmortem owner: Jason.
Emma R.: Uploaded full traces, added correlation mapping: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1862345601/traces.json.gz
Jason L.: Starting timeline draft: 11:54 first healthy->error delta, 11:58 small climb, 12:01 exponential tail starts, 12:03 routing override applied, 12:06 scale +2 applied, 12:08 5xx back to baseline.
Maria P.: customer-rep notes: two enterprise customers reported timeouts in that window, raising incident severity on their side. I’ll send a shared timeline.
Alex K.: Hypotheses to validate in RCA: (A) retry amplification causing avalanche; (B) single slow worker due to GC or blocking IO; (C) load shape changed due to malformed client requests. Need evidence for each.
Emma R.: Thread dump shows a blocking syscall in worker 7: `read()` stuck on socket for 30s during that period.
Infra SRE: kernel dmesg shows intermittent TCP RSTs to runtime-12 host b/c of ephemeral port exhaustion. suspect connection churn from heavy retry duplicates.
Jason L.: Next steps: change default retry jitter back to pre-change for safe defaults, add rate-limit on retries at gateway, add correlation id sampling for deeper traces.
Alex K.: For now incident is in mitigation state. leaving thread open for RCA notes. on-call handoff at 13:00 UTC to Maria — I will update postmortem outline. :white_check_mark:
Maria P.: Acknowledged handoff. I’ll take postmortem owner if Alex is ok.
Alex K.: assigning postmortem to Jason as stated earlier, Maria will coordinate customer comms. Thanks team.
Emma R.: final note: I’ll attach GC logs and a short reproducer for infra to run.
Jason L.: Adding follow-ups to incident board: retry-policy defaults, connection pool telemetry, graceful-fallback test.
Incident Bot: Incident P0 moved to MITIGATED state at 2026-03-15T12:08:28Z.
